name: cs-circuit-16
description: Default general-purpose 16-color palette for game sprites, with hue-shifted ramps around a white and cyan circuit-board theme.

name: cs-circuit-32
description: 32-color extension of cs-circuit-16 (its first 16 colors are identical) that fills out every ramp for richer sprites and tiles.

name: bw-1bit
description: Two-color 1-bit palette of pure black and pure white.

name: gray-4
description: Four evenly spaced greys from black to white (value = i * 255 // 3).

name: gray-8
description: Eight evenly spaced greys from black to white (value = i * 255 // 7).
